ut_isss.title: UT Texas Global ISSS - Scholarships and financial services

test_policy.notes: At least one official SAT or ACT score must be sent by the testing agency (self-report in MyStatus allowed, official must arrive by the deadline). Classic Learning Test (CLT) also satisfies the requirement. SAT Essay/ACT Writing not required. Matches CDS C8A (required to be considered).

requirements.supplemental_essays: At least one essay plus required short-answer prompts
requirements.notes: Platforms: Common App or ApplyTexas. Fee is $75 domestic; international applicants pay $90 and fee waivers are not available to international students. Up to two recommendation letters may be submitted (not mandatory per the page).

deadlines.label: Early Action
deadlines.notes: Supplemental materials due Oct 22. Decision or deferral by Jan 15, 2027.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Supplemental materials due Dec 10. Honors decisions March 1.

english_policy.waiver_notes: International applicants must submit TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo unless they graduate from a high school in the US or a listed qualifying country after at least three years of study there. Not accepted: institutional TOEFL (ITP), TOEFL Essentials, IELTS General Training.

english.notes: Overall band on the Academic exam

aid.notes: UT's ISSS lists certain scholarships open to international students, but awards are one-time and several (e.g. General ISSS Financial Aid) require at least two semesters at UT first. UT's pages opened did not state whether incoming international first-years can receive need-based aid, so no aid policy is recorded.

sat.note: Official scores must be sent by the testing agency.

act.note: Official scores must be sent by the testing agency.

ielts.note: No institutional code. Send via IELTS electronic score delivery to the 'University of Texas at Austin' account.

duolingo.note: No institutional code. Select 'University of Texas at Austin - Undergraduate Admissions' when sending.

tier_notes.engineering: Cockrell is a top-10 engineering school.
tier_notes.business: McCombs is a top-10 undergraduate business program (accounting is top-ranked).
tier_notes.nursing: School of Nursing is a top-15 undergraduate nursing program.
